set.game[description]:
Want the whole set? The PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

Courtyard is 14 low poly PS1-style residents of a 1990s post-Soviet apartment block courtyard, for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal, rigged and animated, with a free sampler on this page. Every character has 45 animation clips on one humanoid skeleton, 3 palette skins (42 to place), 1,494 to 1,498 triangles and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. Use them in any number of commercial games, no attribution required.

What you get

  • 14 neighbours for an Eastern Bloc housing estate: a babushka in a headscarf and quilted coat, an old chess player in a flat cap, a lad in a plain tracksuit, a student in a denim jacket, a kiosk vendor in a mohair cardigan, a neighbour in a white vest, a taxi driver in a leather jacket, a patrolman in a peaked cap, a postwoman, a plumber in a work coverall, a yard sweeper in an orange quilted jacket and knit cap, a schoolteacher, a night-shift nurse and a pensioner in a fur hat. Every one an adult, each a different body and painted outfit.
  • Post-Soviet from the clothes: the costumes carry the setting by cut and colour, with no stars, badges, insignia, logos or text, so they stand in the PSX courtyards, apartment blocks and kiosks already on the shelf.
  • Real hats: the flat cap, the peaked cap, the knit cap and the fur hat are modelled geometry that holds its shape from every angle and through every clip.
  • 3 palette skins each: one garment (or the whole tracksuit, uniform or coverall) changes colour; faces, hair, glasses, gloves and shoes keep their paint.
  • 45 animation clips plus a T-pose: idle, walk, formal walk, jog, sprint, crouch, jump, roll, punches, pistol aim, shoot and reload, sword, spell, two hit reactions, a death, sit, sit and talk, swim, push, pick up, interact, kneel and fix, talking, torch idle, dance and driving.
  • PSX ready: textures quantised to 15-bit colour for nearest filtering, and a PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snapping, affine texture warp, dithering, distance fog).
  • Per character: a GLB with every clip, a GLB per extra skin, FBX with the skeleton and clips, OBJ + MTL, PNG textures and the Blender source.

Limits: the hands are simple mittens and nothing is held, so the chess set, the broom, the bags and the dog are yours to attach (the sit, talk and pick up clips are on every character). The bodies are close fitting, so there are no skirts, dresses or long coats: every coat ends at the hip.

In your project

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project and instance a _skin0.glb. Tested in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project: every GLB imports, the shader compiles and the clips play.

Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX and set the textures to point filtering; the skeleton retargets with Unity Humanoid or an Unreal IK Rig. These two engines were not run here; the FBX files were re-imported in Blender to check the mesh, 53 bones and every clip. The full Readme has the import notes and the clip list.

Try it free

The free sampler on this page is the babushka: all three skins, every clip, every format and the shader. The PSX Characters Sampler is a separate free download with one character from each of our other PSX packs.

Pairs with: Crosstown (PSX modern city civilians) and Blackwater (PSX infected and zombies), both on the same skeleton.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or free games, no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models, textures or animations themselves as assets. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library; the bodies are generated with MakeHuman (CC0 output).

Made with AI tools: the bodies were built by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. Code: yes. Graphics: yes. Sounds: no. Text: no.

Rate it or leave a comment if it works in your game. Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
